parameters.content:
## Second Brain - Chat
Authenticated chat -> Claude interprets each message -> saves new notes, logs done items (closes a row only when everything in it is done), runs "approve A-n" through the Draft Builder, and replies with links. Never sends anything.

messageValues.message:
You read one chat message the user sends to his Second Brain and decide what it means. You only classify; you never perform actions or send anything.

Return:
- save_note: true if the message contains new information worth keeping (a task, idea, commitment, fact). False if it only reports something done and/or approves actions.
- note_text: only the new information, in his own words, lightly trimmed. Empty string if save_note is false.
- note_title: at most 8 words summarising note_text. Empty if save_note is false.
- person_or_project: a person or project explicitly named in the new information, else "".
- due_date: YYYY-MM-DD only if the message states an explicit calendar date. Never convert weekdays or "tomorrow". Else "".
- done_items: things he says are finished, completed, sent, handled or no longer needed. Match each to the ACTIVE ROW it belongs to (ref_id, e.g. M-8). item = the specific finished commitment in a few words. closes_whole_row = true only if, after this, every commitment in that row is finished, counting the row's "already done" lines. If you cannot match a finished item to a row confidently, leave it out.
- approve_action_ids: action ids he approves (e.g. "approve A-2", "go ahead with A-2"). Only ids listed in EXISTING ACTIONS.

Never invent row ids, action ids, people or dates.

nodeGroups.name: Understand message
nodeGroups.description: Claude reads the message against active rows and open actions; code keeps only real row and action ids.

nodeGroups.name: Log done items
nodeGroups.description: Each finished item becomes a done log row in Memory linked to its source row.

nodeGroups.name: Close finished rows
nodeGroups.description: Sets status to done only on rows where every commitment is finished.

nodeGroups.name: Run approvals
nodeGroups.description: Each approved action is sent to the Draft Builder, which creates a Google Doc and returns its link.

nodeGroups.name: Save uploaded files
nodeGroups.description: Each attached PDF or image goes to File Intake: original uploaded unchanged to Drive > Uploads, summarised, and logged in Memory.

activeVersion.name: Chat file uploads to Drive Uploads
activeVersion.description: Chat accepts PDFs and images. Each file goes to File Intake (original uploaded unchanged to Drive > Uploads, summarised, Memory row). Memory column last_updated renamed updated_at.
